title: Germany – Construction work – Neubau Kita Kruft
description: Bei dem Bauvorhaben handelt es sich um den Neubau einer Kindertagesstätte in der Vulkanstraße in 56642 Kruft. Das Baugrundstück liegt in einem Hanggelände im Nord-Osten der bebauten Ortslage von Kruft. Zufahrt und Andienung der Baustelle erfolgen über die Vulkanstraße als öffentlicher Verkehrsweg. Die Kita wird als T-förmiges Gebäude mit einer Kantenlänge von ca. 42 x 40 m errichtet. Durch die Hanglage wird der Baukörper in der Höhe zweigeschossig gestaffelt: auf Eingangsniveau, das von der Vulkanstraße aus erschlossen wird, befindet sich der Zugang zur Kita, der Verwaltungsbereich, der Mehrzweckraum, das Bistro und die Küche, Technikräume sowie die Krippengruppe mit Nebenräumen. Im "Obergeschoß", das sich ebenerdig zu den Freiflächen am Hang öffnet, befinden sich weitere fünf Gruppenräume mit Neben- und Schlafräumen sowie der Personalräume . Vor den Gruppenräumen befindet sich ein überdachtes Spieldeck, das den Zugang zu dem Außenspielgelände ermöglicht. Das Dach des Baukörpers im Erdgeschoß und Teile des Dachs des Obergeschosses werden extensiv begrünt. Auf der Pultdachfläche des Obergeschosses werden zusätzlich Photovoltaik-Module errichtet. Fläche des Baugrundstückes: insgesamt ca. 13.370 m2 Überbauter Bereich: insgesamt ca. 2.290 m2 Bauteile und Baustoffe: Stahlbetonbodenplatte gemäß Statik und Bodengutachten; Einzelfundamente/Streifenfundamente aus Stahlbeton, nach DIN EN 1992 auf Gründungspolster (Schotter); oberseitige Schweißbahnabdichtung. Außenwände: einschaliges Mauerwerk, d= 36,5cm, aus Wärmedämm-Leichtbetonstein; wärmegedämmte Betonbauteile (Stürze, Stützen, etc.) mit Putz und Anstrich Innenwände: alle tragenden und nichttragenden Innenwände werden in Mauerwerk bzw. in Stahlbeton gem. Statik ausgeführt. Dachkonstruktion EG : Flachdach als massive Stahlbetondecke Dachkonstruktion OG: flach geneigtes Dach in Holzbauweise mit statischen Sonderelementen in Profilstahl; Gefälle ca. 3,5% Dacheindeckung : Warmdach mit Wärmedämmung als Auf- und in Teilen auch Zwischensparrendämmung gem. GEG-Berechnung/-planung, Abdichtung 2-lagig mittels gründachgeeigneter Bitumenschweißbahnen Fensterkonstruktion: Fenster- u. Fenstertüren aus Kunststoff mit 3-fach Isolierverglasung, gem. GEG-Nachweis; Außenfensterbänke aus Aluminium. Große Fenster- und Fenstertürelemente:Aluminium mit 3-fach Isolierverglasung, gem. GEG-Nachweis. Verdunklung/Sonnenschutz: elektr. betriebene Textilscreens und Raffstore je nach Einsatzgebiet. Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung ist das Los 10 Raumlufttechnik.

Hankinnassa sähköenergian hinta muodostuu fyysisen sähkön spot-toimituksesta, hintariskin vähentämiseksi tehtyjen tehopohjaisten hinnankiinnitysten selvityksestä, uusiutuvan sähkön alkuperätodistusten hankinnasta, toimittajan marginaalista sekä kantaverkkoyhtiö Fingridin kulloinkin voimassa olevasta tuotannon ja kulutuksen volyymimaksusta. Hankinnan määräaikainen sopimuskausi on 1.1.2029 - 31.12.2030. Sen lisäksi hankintaan sisältyy sopimusosapuolten yhteisesti päätettävä jatko-optio 1.1.2031 -31.12.2032. Tilaajien yhteenlaskettu sähköenergian hankinta on noin 38,2 GWh/vuosi. Ilmoitettu määrä on arvio, jossa esiintyy vuosittaista vaihtelua. Tilaajakohtaisia käyttöpaikkamääriä ja arvioituja sähköenergian hankintamääriä on tarkemmin kuvattu tarjouspyynnön liitteessä. Kaikki esitetyt käyttöpaikkamäärät ja volyymit ovat arvioita, eivätkä hankintayksikkö ja tilaajat sitoudu niiden mukaisiin hankintamääriin. Tarjoajia pyydetään tutustumaan kaikkiin tarjouspyynnön liitteenä oleviin asiakirjoihin ja huomioimaan ne tarjousta tehdessään. Hankintaan valitaan yksi (1) toimittaja.

title: Finland – System maintenance services – Turvajärjestelmien huolto- ja ylläpitopalveluiden hankinta
description: Hankinnan kohteena on Oulun yliopiston ja Oulun Ammattikorkeakoulu Oy:n (OAMK) turvajärjestelmien ylläpitopalvelu. Hankinnan tavoitteena on muodostaa Tilaajalle yhtenäinen toimintamalli turvajärjestelmien ylläpitoon, huoltoon, muutostöihin ja elinkaaren hallintaan. Hankinta koskee Tilaajan turvajärjestelmiä kaikissa sen kohteissa. Hankinnan piiriin kuuluvat myös sopimuskauden aikana käyttöönotettavat uudet kohteet sekä olemassa oleviin kohteisiin toteutettavat laajennukset ja muutokset. Tällä hetkellä Oulun yliopisto toimii ensisijaisena tilaajana ja läpilaskuttaa kustannukset Oulun Ammattikorkeakoululta (OAMK). Sopimuskauden aikana myös Oamkilla voi syntyä omia hankintatarpeita, jotka liittyvät esimerkiksi järjestelmien uudistamiseen tai korvaamiseen. Oulun yliopiston konsulttina tässä kilpailutuksessa toimii Seclion Oy. Hankinnan kuvaus tarkemmin liitteissä "Hankinnan yleiskuvaus" ja "Palvelukuvaus".

title: SPS-02372 Conservation Strategy for Selected SPS Historic Estate Assets
description: The Scottish Prison Service (SPS) requires a suitably qualified multidisciplinary supplier to prepare three (3) Conservation Strategies for selected historic assets across its estate. The commission will cover the following sites: HMP Barlinnie (Glasgow), HMP Castle Huntly (near Dundee) and HMP Perth (Perth). The Conservation Strategies will act as practical, significance-led management tools to support maintenance, repair, operation, adaptation, and future decision-making for historic and listed buildings. The work will include (but is not limited to): 1) Review of baseline information and historic development 2) Building and fabric surveys 3) Structural appraisal input 4) Significance assessments 5) Condition surveys and defect registers 6) Preparation of marked-up drawings showing significance and risk 7) Development of prioritised action plans (short to long term) 8) Maintenance and operational guidance for estates teams 9) Advice on statutory consent and engagement with Historic Environment Scotland and planning authorities 10) Site-specific conservation policies The outputs will comprise three Conservation Strategies, one per site, supported by drawings, action plans, and guidance documents.

title: RFSO -Coastal imaging, habitat classification, shoreline assessment in Canada
description: The Department of Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO) has a requirement to establish a Standing Offer to provide professional services for the design, implementation, review, and maintenance of coastal imaging and habitat classification data and products for all Canadian coasts. The Contractor will use their expertise in coastal imaging, conducting aerial imaging and ground truthing surveys, and processing aerial imagery to produce open-source data products. The goal is to support DFO in shoreline classification, species, habitat and ecosystem vulnerability, and ocean protection. Specific goals include completing aerial imaging, stills, video, and ground truthing surveys, characterization and mapping of shoreline attributes, identification and characterization of biologically significant species and habitats, characterization of shoreline and nearshore species and habitats for wave exposure and oil residency indices, database creation and services, and publication of end products and reports. DFO will benefit from these services by efficiently collecting, processing, analyzing, and documenting data for the Ocean Protection Plan and spill response planning initiatives. Canada intend to establish one (1) Standing Offer (SO) to a qualified supplier who can provide the services to meet the general needs outlined in the Statement of Work Annex. The period of the Standing Offer will be from date of SO issuance until September 30, 2031. The Request for Standing Offers (RFSO) is to establish a National Individual Standing Offer for the requirement detailed in the RFSO, to the Identified Users across Canada, excluding locations within Yukon, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, Quebec, and Labrador that are subject to Comprehensive Land Claims Agreements (CLCAs). Any requirement for deliveries to locations within CLCAs areas within Yukon, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, Quebec, or Labrador will have to be treated as a separate procurement, outside of the resulting standing offers. The requirement is subject to World Trade Organization-Agreement on Government Procurement (WTO-AGP), Canada - European Union Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA), and the Canadian Free Trade Agreement (CFTA).

title: APN_ONTARIO ARMOURIES SITE ENHANCEMENT PROGRAM VARIOUS ONTARIO LOCATIONS
description: Advance Procurement Notice CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT SERVICES FOR: ONTARIO ARMOURIES SITE ENHANCEMENT PROGRAM VARIOUS ONTARIO LOCATIONS (with Security Requirements) Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform contractors of an upcoming contract opportunity in Hamilton and other locations in Southern and Central Ontario. The purpose of this APN is to allow contractors to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process, notably by initiating any necessary steps. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested contractors to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable). Please note that this project may include Indigenous businesses participation component in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process. Description of the Project and Services This project will address infrastructure requirements to recapitalize Department of National Defence reserve and armoury infrastructure at multiple sites throughout Southern and Central Ontario. The delivery method for much of this project is anticipated to be Construction Management. The purpose of this project is to retain the services of a contractor to provide construction management services during the pre-construction and construction phases. The program is anticipated to include planned phased work packages implemented over a 7-10 year period while maintaining operations at the sites. Construction Management services are anticipated to support delivery of Track A (HMCS Star and CFRB Hamilton), are expected to support delivery of Track B (six armouries), and may be expanded in the future to include Track C (thirteen additional armouries). Major construction services are expected to include: Vertical infrastructure; construction of new facilities, recapitalization of existing facilities, and upgrades to building systems and components. Horizontal infrastructure; water distribution, wastewater collection, electrical distribution, communications systems, natural gas distribution, security infrastructure, site services, roads, parking areas and related civil works. The estimated construction cost is in the order of $100,000,000, consisting of approximately $60,000,000 for Track A and $40,000,000 for Track B. Additional future work associated with Track C may increase the overall program value by up to an additional $110,000,000. It is anticipated that this solicitation will be initiated in November 2026. This is conditional on receiving approval to proceed by the Department of National Defence (DND). Contract Award and Anticipated Security Requirements To be eligible for contract award, a proponent will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is Designated Organization Screening (DOS). Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing contractors early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, contractors that intend to submit a proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, consultants or contractors are asked to quote the following information, among other things: Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number (Project number on the MERX notice); Contract number 88064; and Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the consultants or contractors to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a consultant or contractor: has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation (Contract number listed on their request for sponsorship) being advertised on MERX, has met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package, and has submitted a proposal or a bid. DCC will  send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent or bidder regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent or bidder will need to promptly cooperate with CSP  to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible. Questions Any questions pertaining to the sponsoring process through the ISP can be addressed to: Telephone Number: (613) 998-8974; or Email address: ISP.Sponsorship@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Any questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to: Lucia Apted Coordinator, Contract Services Defence Construction Canada TTcontracting@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Disclaimer DCC is only providing assistance, at its entire discretion, for the above stated sponsorship process  and does not provide any representations or guarantees that a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application forwarded by DCC to the CSP will be successful or result in the granting of the requested security clearance(s) by the CSP. At all times, the processing of a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application is subject to the respective terms, conditions, and timelines of DCC’s ISP sponsorship process and the CSP security clearance granting process. By applying to either of the aforementioned processes, the proponent or bidder agrees to bear any fees and risks associated with: (i) the completeness or accuracy, or lack thereof, of its application or related documents submitted under or in connection with either said processes, and (ii) the timeliness, or lack thereof, of any processing or granting of security clearance(s) under or in connection with either said processes. Notwithstanding anything else stated above, DCC shall in no event be liable to the bidder or proponent for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential, punitive or exemplary damages arising out or in connection with the above stated sponsorship process.  Bidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. title: Subscription licenses to BNEF Bloomberg
description: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada (ISED) supports informed decision-making on major industrial, economic development and clean technology initiatives. To fulfil this mandate, the Department requires reliable and up-to-date intelligence on global clean technology markets, investment flows, industrial trends, policy developments, emerging technologies and energy transition sectors. The Department has relied on BloombergNEF (BNEF) subscriptions to conduct research, monitor international market developments, assess investment opportunities, compare Canada's competitive position against other jurisdictions and support advice provided to senior government officials. BloombergNEF provides comprehensive market intelligence and analytical tools covering the clean technology and energy transition sectors that are not otherwise available through publicly accessible sources or other subscription services.

title: Belgium – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – CEFTA Cloud Infrastructure, Hosting, Managed Services, Security and Business Continuity
description: Maintenance, support and management of CEFTA cloud infrastructure, hosting, managed services, security and business continuity. The contract will cover the end-to-end operation, administration, monitoring, maintenance, security, backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, and optimisation of CEFTA’s cloud-hosted infrastructure and related ICT services. This includes Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Oracle databases, WebLogic middleware components, cloud and software licences, security platforms and tools, hosting environments, and associated support arrangements. The services will ensure the stable, secure, resilient, and continuous operation of CEFTA digital systems and applications, including Customs SEED+, CEFTA TRACES NT, and other related platforms and services. The contractor shall ensure the availability, confidentiality, integrity, and resilience of CEFTA’s infrastructure, systems, applications, and data, in line with industry best practices and applicable security, compliance, and governance requirements. The scope includes infrastructure and platform administration, performance monitoring and tuning, capacity planning, availability management, patch and configuration management, incident, problem, change and release management, and service request fulfilment. The contractor shall provide a combination of proactive and reactive operational support. Proactive services will include continuous monitoring, preventive maintenance, performance and capacity management, security assessments, vulnerability management, patching, security hardening, resilience improvements, cost optimisation, compliance support, and recommendations for continuous service enhancement. Reactive services will include incident response, troubleshooting, service restoration, problem resolution, emergency remediation activities, security incident handling, and support for unplanned events affecting the availability, performance, integrity, or security of CEFTA systems and services. The contract will also include security monitoring, threat detection, cybersecurity risk assessments, vulnerability remediation, backup management, disaster recovery planning and testing, business continuity planning and validation, data protection measures, recovery readiness activities, cloud cost management, infrastructure lifecycle management, operational reporting, service-level performance tracking, documentation maintenance, knowledge transfer, and technical and architectural advisory services, ensuring alignment with CEFTA’s operational, security, and strategic business objectives while maintaining the confidentiality, integrity, availability, and recoverability of CEFTA information assets and digital services.

title: SPS-02372 Conservation Strategy for Selected SPS Historic Estate Assets
description: The Scottish Prison Service (SPS) requires a suitably qualified multidisciplinary supplier to prepare three (3) Conservation Strategies for selected historic assets across its estate. The commission will cover the following sites: HMP Barlinnie (Glasgow), HMP Castle Huntly (near Dundee) and HMP Perth (Perth). The Conservation Strategies will act as practical, significance-led management tools to support maintenance, repair, operation, adaptation, and future decision-making for historic and listed buildings. The work will include (but is not limited to): 1) Review of baseline information and historic development 2) Building and fabric surveys 3) Structural appraisal input 4) Significance assessments 5) Condition surveys and defect registers 6) Preparation of marked-up drawings showing significance and risk 7) Development of prioritised action plans (short to long term) 8) Maintenance and operational guidance for estates teams 9) Advice on statutory consent and engagement with Historic Environment Scotland and planning authorities 10) Site-specific conservation policies The outputs will comprise three Conservation Strategies, one per site, supported by drawings, action plans, and guidance documents.

title: 6515--NX EQ Physiologic Motility Analyzers (EndoFLIP)
description: Solicitation Number:� � 36C10X26R0054 � Notice Type:� � Combined Synopsis/Solicitation� � This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) subpart 12.6, Streamlined Procedures for Evaluation and Solicitation for Commercial Items, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; proposals are being requested, and a written solicitation will not be issued.� Solicitation number 36C10X26R0054 is issued for this combined synopsis/solicitation; this solicitation is being issued as a Request for Proposal (RFP). This combined synopsis/solicitation incorporates provisions and clauses in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular (FAC) 2026-01, dated 13 March 2026.� Requirement Description:� VA has a requirement to purchase the Medtronic EndoFLIP 300 system and related accessories and to deliver the same to its VA Medical Centers around the country. The EndoFLIP 300 provides real-time measurements of the pressure and dimensions of the esophagus during endoscopic evaluation and surgical procedures through Impedance Planimetry. Impedance Planimetry is described as a catheter-mounted, balloon-covered probe placed during a regular endoscopy using sedation and inflated to prespecified pressures. During inflation, pressure sensors along the balloon measure intraluminal pressure and cross-sectional areas within a gastrointestinal lumen or sphincter. The measurements are used to calculate a distensibility index (mm2/mm Hg) or compliance of the evaluated area. A single award, Brand Name Only Requirements contract will be awarded for Medtronic EndoFLIP accordance with all terms, conditions, provisions, specifications, and schedule of this solicitation herein. Proposals shall contain the terms for cost/price. The Government reserves the right to award without discussions.� � The associated North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code for this procurement is 339113 Surgical Appliance and Supplies Manufacturing, Product Service Code: 6515 Medical and Surgical Instruments, Equipment, and Supplies. This procurement action is Unrestricted Full and Open.� This acquisition anticipates award of a single award Requirements contract in accordance with FAR Part 16.503 for Medtronic EndoFLIP 300 System and related accessories as identified in ATTACHMENT A PRICE COST SCHEDULE - NX EQ PHYSIOLOGIC MOTILITY ANALYZERS ENDOFLIP. All interested companies shall provide a proposal for all Contract Line-Item Numbers (CLINs) listed in ATTACHMENT A PRICE COST SCHEDULE - NX EQ PHYSIOLOGIC MOTILITY ANALYZERS ENDOFLIP. Only Medtronic products will be considered for award. The ordering period is for one 12-month base year with four 12-month option years. Delivery is a FOB destination. Firm-Fixed Price Orders will be placed against this contract in writing and will provide the delivery locations, delivery dates and exact quantities.� � The FAR provision at 52.212-1, Instructions to Offerors Commercial Products and Commercial Services, applies to this acquisition including attached addenda to the provision.� The FAR provision at 52.212-2, Evaluation -- Commercial Products and Commercial Services Items, and the specific evaluation criteria as attached addenda also applies to this acquisition.� Clause 52.212-4, Terms and Conditions -- Commercial Products and Commercial Services, applies to this acquisition and a statement regarding any addenda to the clause.� Addendum is attached.� All interested offerors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) prior to submitting a quote. You may access SAM at� https://sam.gov/SAM/.� Questions regarding this combined synopsis/solicitation are due via email by 10:00 AM Eastern Standard Time (EST) on September 29, 2026, to Contract Specialist, Jalima Jones at Jalima.Jones@va.gov and Contracting Officer Anthony Zibolski at Anthony.Zibolski@va.gov No calls will be accepted. Proposals are due via email by 10:00 AM EST on October 06, 2026, to Contract Specialist, Jalima Jones at Jalima.Jones@va.gov and Contracting Officer Anthony Zibolski at Anthony.Zibolski@va.gov SCOPE OF WORK� � � The Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Non-Expendable Equipment National Program has identified Physiologic Motility Analyzers (Medtronic EndoFLIP ) product line as a candidate for a VA-wide (otherwise referred to as national ) single Requirements contract award.� � Physiologic Motility Analyzers determine the peristaltic smooth movement of some part of the digestive tract (e.g,. esophagus, stomach, small intestine, colon) and the intraluminal pressure exerted on its content. Most of these analyzers can evaluate motility in several areas on the intestinal tract using interchangeable dedicated catheters and accessories for different applications. Motility study results provide information necessary for prescribing treatment such as surgery, drug therapy, and biofeedback therapy. The Contractor must demonstrate the ability to meet all requirements for the solicitation. The objective is to provide Medtronic EndoFLIP Physiologic Motility Analyzers to be used by VHA clinicians throughout the United States and its territories. The period of performance is for one 12-month base period with four 12-month option periods.� 2. REQUIREMENT� This requirement will be brand name only for Physiologic Motility Analyzers which requires the offeror indicate that the product being offered is the Medtronic EndoFLIP and related accessories. The offeror must also clearly identify each item by brand name (Medtronic EndoFLIP ) including part/model number. The following line-items comprise the Physiologic Motility Analyzers product line: Contract Line-Item Number Brand Part Number Description 0001 Medtronic 47229 ENDOFLIPTM 300 SYSTEM 0002 Medtronic 47230 ENDOFLIPTM 300 EXISTING CUSTOMER PROMO (FOR EXISTING EF 100, 200 SYSTEMS 0003 Medtronic 80488 1-DAY ON-SITE TRAINING 0004 Medtronic 80489 2-DAY ON-SITE TRAINING 0005 Medtronic EF-304 ENDOFLIP 300 READER 0006 Medtronic EF-305 ENDOFLIP PRE-USE TUBE 0007 Medtronic EF-322N ENDO CATHETER 16CM NASAL TIP 0008 Medtronic EF-325N ENDO CATHETER 8CM NASAL TIP 0009 Medtronic ES-310 CATHETER 10MM ESO DILATION 0010 Medtronic ES-320 CATHETER 20MM ESO DILATION 0011 Medtronic ES-330 CATHETER 30MM ESO DILATION 0012 Medtronic ES-ENDOFLIP3001 ONE YEAR SERVICE PLAN 0013 Medtronic ES-ENDOFLIP3002 TWO-YEAR SERVICE PLAN 0014 Medtronic ES-ENDOFLIP3003 THREE-YEAR SERVICE PLAN 0015 Medtronic LK-200 PRE USE CHECK KIT FLIP The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) is seeking vendors who can provide brand name Medtronic EndoFLIP 300 for Physiologic Motility Analyzers as listed above. title: INDUSTRY DAY: Fort Carson Equipment Concentration Site - Construction Management at Risk using Other Transaction Authority (CM@Risk w/OTA)
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) is issuing this special notice to announce an upcoming competition for construction solicitation for Fort Carson ECS using CM@Risk under 10 USC �2808a Other Transaction Authority for Construction. This notice is for informational and planning purposes to allow interested parties to prepare for and provide feedback prior to the official solicitation release. I. INDUSTRY DAY USACE intends to conduct an Industry Day on 06 October 2026 at 0900 Mountain Time to provide an overview of the project, acquisition strategy, and anticipated requirements. This event will provide interested parties with an opportunity to gain additional insight into the project and proposed Construction Manager at Risk (CM@Risk) approach under an Other Transaction (OT) framework, ask questions, and provide input in advance of the official Request for Qualifications (RFQ) release. General questions from industry participants will be permitted during the Industry Day; however, all discussions and responses provided during the event are considered unofficial and are for informational purposes only. Statements made during the Industry Day do not constitute a commitment, authorization, or binding guidance related to the future Request for Qualifications (RFQ). Official Questions and Answers (Q&A) will be accepted and addressed following the release of RFQ. Please use the direct special event link below to register for access to Fort Carson. You must be a U.S. Citizen and have a REAL ID to complete registration. If you do not, you must go the Fort Carson Visitor Control Center (located at Gate 1, located off 115 HW) with your State ID plus a U.S. Passport OR Certified birth certificate and Social Security Card to obtain access. Individuals with a valid CAC, should be able to access the installation directly. Direct Special Event Link https://pass.aie.army.mil/?b=usa&i=carson&e=M6JLHPVK Physical Access Control POC: Mark Elliott (719) 466-1132 mark.d.elliott24.civ@army.mil II. LOCATION/LOGISTICS Industry Day Presentation location: Butts Army Airfield Hangar � 9620 Son Tay Road NOTE: Onsite parking space may be limited, overflow parking is available in the vicinity Site Visit � Primary parking lot is at the CBRN Chamber across the tank trail at the intersection of Minick Ave and Prussman Blvd. Additional parking is available on Minick Ave less than a quarter mile NW of the CBRN Chamber lot. Onsite Directions Link Below. Turn by turn directions and map attached for download. https://maps.app.goo.gl/U4o1XusLDWip4gn87 III. PROJECT OVERVIEW Project Title: Construction of an Equipment Concentration Site (ECS) Complex Location: Fort Carson, Colorado Agency: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Louisville District NAICS Code: 236220 IV. PROJECT DESCRIPTION This acquisition will deliver a consolidated, fully functional ECS complex on an undeveloped 48-acre parcel of land at Fort Carson, CO. This site features a comprehensive range of facilities designed to support the mission of ECS-42, which is responsible for the maintenance and storage of key military assets assigned to 83 regional Army Reserve units. The operational readiness of this military equipment is essential for both training Army Reserve Soldiers and equipping units from which the Active component will draw upon for critical warfighting capabilities inherent to deployable combat forces. Core Facilities include: General Purpose Warehouse (GPW): A 39,313 square-foot (SF) secure, clear-span storage facility designed for the protection and preservation of military equipment. Area Maintenance Support Activity (AMSA) Shop: A 26,217 SF vehicle maintenance facility featuring advanced vehicle maintenance exhaust systems, overhead cranes, heavy-duty hoists, and specialized tool rooms. Organizational Storage Building: A 5,000 SF high-bay vertical storage facility. Container Storage Area: A 4,440-square-yard (SY) reinforced concrete layout for secure tactical container storage. Supporting Infrastructure & Specialized Systems include: Heavy Equipment Parking & Site Work: A Military Equipment Parking (MEP) lot featuring extensive heavy-duty concrete pavements designed to withstand high-shear tracked and wheeled tactical vehicle loads, alongside POV parking, security fencing, and utility tie-ins. Tactical Vehicle Wash Facilities: Two dedicated, high-capacity vehicle wash racks/platforms featuring industrial filtration and water-recycling systems. Bi-Level Loading Ramp: A reinforced bi-level loading ramp designed to facilitate the rapid loading and unloading of heavy armored vehicles onto transport carriers. Specialized Foundations: Geotechnical engineering solutions, including deep foundation systems and soil stabilization, to mitigate volatile soil conditions across the 48-acre site. Fire Protection: Advanced fire detection and suppression systems, including specialized solutions for high-bay maintenance areas and hazardous material storage, compliant with all relevant UFC and NFPA standards. Cybersecurity: Facility-related control systems will be designed and implemented in accordance with UFC 4-010-06, ensuring the cybersecurity of all networked building systems. UFC Compliance: The entire facility complex will be designed and constructed to meet all applicable Unified Facilities Criteria (UFC), including AT/FP (Antiterrorism/Force Protection) standards and sustainable design principles as outlined in the Army Sustainable Design and Development Policy. V. ACQUISITION STRATEGY - PRE-AWARD USACE, Louisville District will use a streamlined competitive selection process: Step 1 �White Papers: Interested parties will submit a Statement of Qualifications (max # of pages to be defined in formal RFQ). Following evaluation of the qualification packages, the Government intends to down-select up to three (3) highest qualified firms to proceed to Step 2. Step 2 � Pitch Presentations: Down-selected firms will participate in live pitch meetings. One company will be selected as the Construction Manager for negotiation and award of Agreement 1 for preconstruction services. The Government intends to negotiate a Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP) for construction of the ECS, which will be added as a bilateral modification at a later date. VI. ACQUSITION STRATEGY � AWARD The agreement will be awarded to the most qualified Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) to provide preconstruction services and construction. Phase 1 of the CM@Risk agreement will include pre-construction services. The selected CMAR will act as an expert consultant to the Government, collaborating directly with USACE and the third-party Designer of Record during active design progression. The Government�s intent is to award the Phase I Agreement for Preconstruction Services prior to the 65% design review meeting. Phase 2 of the agreement will include scope for all construction activities necessary to complete the project. The agreement will be Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP). All interested parties should monitor the official solicitation announcement, which will provide complete details and submission instructions. Draft documents may be provided at a future date for feedback and informational purposes only and are subject to change upon issuance of the formal Project RFQ. VII. Virtual Participation Opportunity: For those who are unable to attend the Industry Day even in person, the Louisville District plans to stream the event through Microsoft Teams. The details related to the MS Teams event are provided below: Microsoft Teams meeting Join: https://dod.teams.microsoft.us/meet/993580238205?p=NgWECEurH73BprxGc1 Meeting ID: 993 580 238 205 Passcode: kB2Fr9e2

description: Die Unterführungen Steilshooper Straße, Bwk D (005) befinden sich im Hamburger Bezirk Barmbek, Stadtteil Barmbek-Nord und ist Bestandteil des Streckenabschnittes der U-Bahnlinie U3 zwischen den Haltestellen Habichtstraße (HA) und Barmbek (BA). Im Wesentlichen sollen folgende Maßnahmen durchgeführt werden: Teilabbruch und Erneuerung der vorhandenen Betonkonstruktionen der Widerlager (Kammerwände, Auflagerbänke, Vorsatzschalen) und Flügelwände, inkl. Entsorgung. Rückbau der Gründungskonstruktion der Pendelstützen, inkl. Entsorgung. Herstellung der Rückverankerungslagen an den bestehenden, teilweise zurückgebauten Widerlager- und Flügelwänden mit Verpresspfähle einschließlich der erforderlichen Bohrarbeiten und Verpressung. Die Maßnahme soll in einer 30-wöchigen Betriebsunterbrechung umgesetzt werden. Dieses Teilprojekt ist Teil des Gesamtprojekt-komplexes Brücken Barmbek 2027.

title: New World Screwworm Aerial Release & Air Transportation Services
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Part 12. This announcement constitutes only solicitation. Proposals are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number 12639526R0007 is issued as a Request for Proposal (RFP) to establish one or multiple Hybrid T&M and FFP IDIQ commercial contract to support New World Screwworm (NWS) eradication and prevention effort. This contract provides aircraft and crew services for aerial release of sterilized NWS and for transportation of pupae. Pupae will be transported from production facilities (currently in Pacora, Panama) to the dispersal base of operations currently located in Edinburg, Texas. Aerial release base of operations is currently located in Edinburg, Texas. Contractor is expected to perform aerial release along the Texas border into Mexico and in other areas where NWS cases come up. The contractor will work in partnership with USDA APHIS to receive weekly updates regarding the release flight grids and transportation schedule. At any time during the execution of the contract, the number of transportation flights and/or the size of existing dispersal grids, as well as the number of municipalities under treatment, may change, as determined by the COR or his/her designated representative. This acquisition is not set-aside for small business concerns. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 481219. The small business size standard is $25M This acquisition is an unrestricted requirement. All responsible sources may submit a proposal in accordance with solicitation instructions to be considered by the agency. NO LATE PROPOSALS WILL BE ACCEPTED. Please read through document titled CSS _12639526R0007_NWS Aerial Release and Air Transportation first for instructions.

Referenced past performance information should include contract numbers, points of contract with telephone numbers, and a narrative explaining the contract�s relevancy to the solicitation. title: ARTS-V3 Third-Party Software Initiative
description: 1. Introduction and Purpose The United States Air Force is seeking information on industry capabilities for the Advanced Radar Threat System (ARTS) Variant 3 (V3) Variable Aperture Digital Radar (VADR) [ST1] Third-Party Software initiative. This RFI seeks input from industry to: Understand existing commercial and near-term planned capabilities relevant to the development of software for advanced threat emulation for systems like ARTS-V3. Attract both traditional and non-traditional defense contractors. Gauge industry interest in the proposed C5 structure. Refine the acquisition strategy for this software approach 2. Program Background: The ARTS-V3 program develops highly channelized digital Active Electronically Scanned Array (AESA) radar systems to emulate and replicate advanced adversary threat systems. As a ruggedized, closed-loop threat emulator, ARTS-V3 functions as a representative adversary fire control or multi-functional ground-based radar. It is designed with a high degree of hardware and software flexibility, allowing it to incorporate various adversary radar models to simulate how adversaries counter and adapt to contested environments. 3. Proposed OTA Consortium Structure The Government is executing this modernization effort utilizing the Consortium for Command, Control, and Communications in Cyberspace (C5) Other Transaction Authority (OTA) agreement, pursuant to 10 U.S.C. � 4022. Managed by the Consortium Management Group (CMG), this OTA framework significantly compresses acquisition timelines compared to traditional FAR-based contracts. The ARTS-V3 program will issue Requests for White Papers (RWPs) directly to the C5 member base, leveraging an established ecosystem of technology innovators. Eligibility: Interested parties must be members of the C5 consortium to receive awards. Registration: Information on joining can be found at the CMG C5 Overview Portal https://cmgnetworks.org/become-c5-member/ 4. Key Principles for Participation Prospective partners must adhere to the following principles: System Integration: Partner with the Lead System Integrator (LSI) to manage configurations, integrate legacy baselines, test code compliance, and perform post-deployment troubleshooting. Establish formal communication channels with the LSI. MBSE Compliance: Deliver and maintain technical baselines as dynamic, digital model elements using Cameo/SysML. The Government will provide necessary Government Furnished Information (GFI). DevSecOps & Cyber: Utilize the Government's cloud-based software factory and automated CI/CD pipelines. All developments must align with Zero-Trust Architecture (ZTA) and Department of War (DoW) cybersecurity requirements. Development Isolation: Do not reuse, copy, or integrate proprietary code from adjacent vendors. Maintain strict separation between ARTS-V3 ("Red") systems and friendly ("Blue") systems; no cross-system technology reuse is permitted. Cost-Sharing: Provide a one-third (33.3%) cost-share of the total project cost if operating as a traditional DoW vendor acting as the prime performer. 5. Scope of Work, Technical Requirements, & Desired Capabilities Successful partners must demonstrate deep expertise in developing, updating, and integrating advanced threat implementations into the ARTS-V3 system using rigorous, modern software engineering practices. 5.1 Scope of Work & Required Technical Capabilities Radar Integration & DSP: Integrate existing radar or transmit-only reactive models into the ARTS-V3 system. Partner must demonstrate an understanding of radar physics, Electronic Warfare (EW) principles, and the optimization of Digital Signal Processing (DSP) algorithms. Notional Example: Development of software to emulate an emerging X-band threat for an initial capability release. Software Updates & RTOS: Update and maintain existing radar software (e.g., streamlining calibration, improving tracking algorithms, and developing multi-target kinematic tracking filters). Development requires experience with Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) including VxWorks, real-time Linux, modern C++ (C++14/17/20), and hardware-accelerated computing (CUDA, OpenCL). C2 User Interface & Protocols: Update the Command and Control (C2) user interface software, specifically the VADR App (VAPP), with enhanced user interfaces or expanded range capabilities. Design open, non-proprietary APIs (REST, gRPC) aligned with Lead System Integrator (LSI) Interface Control Documents (ICDs) and ensure all messaging functions remain fully compatible with existing system protocols. AESA Resource Management: Develop and implement advanced beam-scheduling and power-management algorithms optimized for Active Electronically Scanned Arrays (AESA). Zero Trust Communications: Implement micro-segmentation and secure communications, enforcing mutual TLS (mTLS 1.3) using FIPS 140-3 validated cryptographic modules to exceed baseline DoW cybersecurity mandates. Modern Programming Practices: Utilize memory-safe programming languages (e.g., Rust, Go, Python, Java) where applicable. Deep working knowledge of C++ remains necessary to successfully utilize the Government Furnished Information (GFI) Software Development Kit (SDK). AI-Assisted Development & Safety: The use of AI coding tools is permitted, provided vendors prevent CUI/DoW data exfiltration. All AI-assisted logic must be clearly identified in an automatically generated Software Bill of Materials (SBOM), undergo strict Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) review, and pass Static (SAST) and Dynamic (DAST) Application Security Testing. AI-Optimized Algorithms: Ensure the development process for advanced tactical edge algorithms aligns directly with Cognitive Electronic Warfare (CogEW) methodologies. 5.2 Desired Capabilities The Government is highly interested in partners who can deliver next-generation enhancements, specifically: Advanced Digital Twin & Closed-Loop Emulation: Novel, closed-loop threat simulations for Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing. AI/ML for Sensor Fusion & Cognitive EW: Embedded tactical-edge capabilities to enhance sensor fusion and threat reaction times. Predictive Maintenance: Advanced algorithms utilizing real-time system telemetry and diagnostic data to predict component failures. Development & Analysis Ecosystems: Specialized radar development environments, code-writing assistance tools, novel radar applications, and robust system analysis tools. GOVERNMENT FURNISHED INFORMATION (GFI) The Government will provide: Applicable threat data from intelligence community members. A Modular Threat Design and Development Template and documentation. Access to the following equipment for testing: Subscale Threat System Anechoic Chamber Cloud-based radar testing Environment Cloud-based Software code verification and Integration Environment Access to the following tools for collaboration: ARTS-V3 VADR and VAPP Software Development Kits (SDK) Containerization tools (e.g., Pod Manager, Docker, Kubernetes) Cameo Models Git repository and container registry (e.g., GitLab) 7. SECURITY Facility: Respondents should describe their classified handling and storage capabilities. An active security clearance is required to access the subscale threat system. Networks: Once under contract, personnel may need access to unclassified and classified networks up to SIPRNet (primarily for Cloud Access). Future Requirements: Respondents do not necessarily have to have a Top Secret clearances nor SAP and SCI access, but the government would like to understand each respondent�s current and future security posture up to TS/SAR and/or TS/SCI including willingness to obtain clearances and estimated timeline. 8. INDUSTRY RESPONSE AND SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS: The Air Combat Command (ACC) and other DoW organizations are supported by this project. The ARTS-V3 Program Office anticipates releasing a request for white papers through the C5 consortium as early as November 2026, with an estimated project aw

title: 9342-Rekonstrukce pískové filtrace na CHÚV
description: Předmětem veřejné zakázky je zpracování a dodání dokumentační části, dodávka a následná realizace díla „9342 – Rekonstrukce pískové filtrace na CHÚV” v JE Dukovany formou dodávky „na klíč“ a provedení všech nutně vyvolaných úprav a jejich odzkoušení na dotčených zařízeních, konstrukcích a systémech. Zhotovitel provede repasování 6 ks stávajících pískových filtrů a úpravu přidružené technologie včetně výměny stávajícího ocelového potrubí a pneumatických ventilů. Konkrétně Zhotovitel demontuje a nahradí vnitřní vestavby pískových filtrů, repasuje nádoby filtrů a nahradí pískovou filtrační hmotu za nový filtrační materiál zlepšující jak technické, tak i ekonomické parametry provozu filtračního zařízení. Zhotovitel také vymění potrubí z uhlíkové oceli vně filtru za plastové potrubí, a to včetně výměny ventilové baterie filtru a osazení nového měření tlaků s místním i vzdáleným odečítáním. Součástí díla je též demontáž 2 ks pískových filtrů i se související technologií. S ohledem na provozní podmínky a zajištění kontinuity provozu bude realizace rozdělena do jednotlivých etap. Přesné vymezení předmětu veřejné zakázky a ostatní požadavky na jeho provedení včetně informací, podmínek, specifikací a ostatních údajů jsou detailně specifikovány v části 3 a 4 Zadávací dokumentace.

This announcement is for the selection and award of one or more Contracts that will support construction needs in our facilities for the Washington, DC Metropolitan area and surrounding facilities such as the Smithsonian Conservation Biology Institute in Front Royal, VA and the Smithsonian Environmental Research Center, Edgewater, MD. REQUEST FOR CLARIFICATIONS It is desired that all questions/clarifications be sent in, sequentially numbered for example first questions 1,2,3, second set of questions 4,5,6, etc. in word format to ColemanSI@si.edu It is requested that all questions be sent in no later than September 15, 2026, at 3PM EST. No site visit has been arranged, if you feel a site visit is warranted, please send an email requesting one. Proposals are to be submitted in pdf form (1 pdf for Technical), emailed to https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/c3gw28mupqeyl8s128jye/AJEscQQlrbA4BYJCnfTPVJI?rlkey=lthtkgmv20f6iyl9u4xgwkgye&st=w3wddft6&dl=0 by 3:00PM ET October 6, 2026.

title: Fall River Lake and Dam Damsite Park Lagoon Repair
description: Amendment 0001 is to correct the Liquidated Damages amount ($1,500.00) and to provide the correct Bidders Key (WFTAEB-RREB2U) for Projnet. Solicitation for the repair, reconstruction, and modernization of the Damsite Park wastewater lagoons at Fall River Lake. The objective is to restore structural integrity, prevent environmental seepage, and ensure full compliance with USACE and State of Kansas environmental regulations at Fall River Lake and Dam in Fall River, Kansas. U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Southwestern Division (SWD), Tulsa District (SWT) intends to issue a commercial contract from solicitation W912BV26Q95 for the Damsite Park Lagoon Repair. The North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) Code is 237990. The resulting contract will be issued on a Firm-Fixed Price basis, to the responsible offeror whose quote is conforming to the requirements of the solicitation and will be most advantageous to the Government considering price, past performance, and conformance with sub-contracting regulations. The anticipated award date is on or about 15 October 2026. The solicitation will be issued via Internet on the PIEE website at https://piee.eb.mil/. It is the responsibility of the contractor to monitor the above-listed internet address for any posted changes. All amendments posted shall be signed and submitted with the quote. Quotes are anticipated to be due on or before 06 October 2026 by 2:00 PM Central Time (CST). Contractors must have an active registration in the System for Award Management (SAM) at time of quote in order to receive a government contract award. SAM registration must also be active at time of award in order to receive a government contract award. SAM registrations shall remain active throughout contract performance to comply with the annual representations and certifications requirements. To register, the SAM.gov Internet address is: https://sam.gov/. Please NOTE this solicitation requires offerors to enter a National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) score in the Supplier Performance Risk System (SPRS). The NIST score is a responsibility item. Those without a NIST score will be deemed NON-RESPONSIBLE and will not be eligible for award. QUESTIONS AND INQUIRIES BIDDERS INQUIRY Any questions and inquiries related to this solicitation shall be submitted through Bidders Inquiry. Please visit www.projnet.org to submit your inquiries. The Solicitation Number is: W912BV26QA095 The Bidder Inquiry Key is: WFTAEB-RREB2U The Bidder Inquiry System is anticipated to be unavailable for new inquiries after 2:00 p.m. on 02 October 2026 to ensure adequate time is allotted to form an appropriate response and amend the solicitation, if necessary.

title: General Services Administration (GSA) Seeks Leased Space in Vicksburg, MS
description: U.S. GOVERNMENT NOTICE OF LEASE REQUIREMENT The General Services Administration (GSA) is seeking expressions of interest from owners and authorized representatives of properties meeting the following requirements: State: Mississippi City: Vicksburg Delineated Area: City Limits of Vicksburg Minimum Sq. Ft. (ABOA): 5,065 Maximum Sq. Ft. (ABOA): 5,500 Space Type: Office Parking Spaces (Total): 0 Full Term: 15 years/10 years firm Tenant Improvement Allowance: $53.06/ABOA SF Building Specific Amortized Capital (BSAC) Allowance: $12.00/ABOA SF Offered space must meet Government requirements for fire safety, accessibility, seismic, and sustainability standards per the terms of the Lease. A fully serviced lease is required. Offered space shall not be in the 1-percent-annual chance floodplain (formerly referred to as 100-year floodplain). Entities are advised to familiarize themselves with the telecommunications prohibitions outlined under Section 889 of the FY19 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), as implemented by the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR). For more information, visit: https://acquisition.gov/FAR-Case-2019-009/889_Part_B. ************************************************************************************************ Expressions of interest must Include. Building name and address; Contact information and e-mail address of offeror�s representative; ABOA SF and rentable square feet available, identifying the specific floors and square footages; Asking full-service rental rate per ABOA SF and RSF inclusive of a standard GSA warm-lit shell; or Asking full-service rental rate per ABOA SF and RSF inclusive of a standard GSA warm-lit shell, a tenant improvement allowance of $XX/ABOA SF, and a BSAC allowance of $XX/ABOA SF; Operating costs per ABOA SF and RSF included in the full-service rates; Submission by anyone other than the owner or manager of a property must be accompanied by written consent from the ownership granting authority to the representative in providing the information to the Government. At least one public transportation stop located within 800 walkable linear feet of the public entrance. Building shall be free of asbestos containing materials. LCO discretion will be applied to deviations. Additional Requirements: 1. Space should not be located near establishments whose primary operation is the sale of alcoholic beverages, firearms sold/discharged, or where there are tenants related to drug treatment or detention facilities. 2. All contiguous space. First floor preferred, if 2 floors, require a minimum of 2 elevators. 3. Space shall be located in a professional office setting and not within close proximity to residential areas, railroad tracks or power transmission lines. 4. Columns must be at least 20 feet apart (center to center) and 20 feet from any interior wall. Expressions of Interest Due: October 6, 2026 Send Expressions of Interest to: Name/Title: Trevor Otto Email Address: trevor.otto@gsa.gov Government Contact Information: Lease Contracting Officer Trevor Otto

title: Pelkosenniemen kunnan tilintarkastuspalvelut 2027-2030 + optio 2031-2032
description: Pelkosenniemen kunnan tilintarkastuspalvelut 2027-2030 + optio 2031-2032 Pelkosenniemen kunta pyytää tarjousta kuntalain (410/2015) mukaisista tilintarkastuspalveluista. Pelkosenniemen kunta on runsaan 900 asukkaan kunta Itä-Lapissa. Kunnan tilinpäätöksen toimintakate vuonna 2025 oli 4,4 miljoonaa euroa. Pelkosenniemen kunta on ulkoistanut kirjanpito- ja palkanlaskentapalvelunsa Monetra Oulu Oy:lle. Hankinnan kohteena on kunnan hallinnon ja talouden tarkastus sekä muut lakisääteiset tilintarkastustehtävät, mukaan lukien kunnan tytäryhteisöjen tilintarkastus. Varsinainen sopimuskausi koskee tilikausien 2027-2030 tilintarkastusta. Hankintayksiköllä on oikeus ottaa käyttöön yksi (1) kahden (2) vuoden optiokausi, joka koskee tilikausien 2031-2032 tilintarkastusta. Palveluun tulee sisältyä vähintään: - kuntalain mukainen hallinnon ja talouden tarkastus; - tilinpäätöksen tarkastus; - tilintarkastuskertomuksen laatiminen; - tarkastuslautakunnan avustaminen sen tarvitsemassa laajuudessa; - osallistuminen tarvittaessa tarkastuslautakunnan kokouksiin; - tarkastushavaintojen raportointi; - muut lakisääteiset tilintarkastustehtävät. Tarkastuksen arvioitu kokonaislaajuus on noin 6-8 tarkastuspäivää vuodessa. Arvio sisältää kunnan sekä sen tytäryhteisöjen tilintarkastuksen. Arvio ei sido hankintayksikköä. Tarjoaja voi esittää oman arvionsa tarkastuspäivien määrästä, mikäli arvio perustellusta syystä poikkeaa hankintayksikön arviosta. Arviota ei huomioida tarjousvertailussa. Tarkastuslautakunta pitää 4–6 kokousta vuodessa. Vastuullinen tilintarkastaja osallistuu asiantuntijana tarkastuslautakunnan kokouksiin tarvittaessa. Tästä muodostuvat kustannukset sisältyvät edellä mainittuun 6-8 tilintarkastuksen tarkastuspäivään. Industry is hereby informed that the FAA Office of Information and Technology (AIT) in support of the Strategic Sourcing for the Acquisition of Various Equipment and Supplies (SAVES) program is seeking an agency-wide indefinite delivery indefinite quantity (IDIQ) contract vehicle that will support FAA�s toner and printer consumable needs. All supplies and services provided under this contract will be performed in accordance with the attached Statement of Work (SOW) and corresponding SOW attachments along with other documents listed in Section J of this Screening Information Request (SIR). This solicitation is Reserved for Small Business under the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) 325992, Photographic Film, Paper, Plate, and Chemical Manufacturing. The small business size standard is 1500 employees. To be considered for award of this requirement, the offeror must have a current/valid registration in the System for Award Management (SAM) database website: www.sam.gov. This announcement is not intended to guarantee procurement of the supplies and shall not be construed as a commitment by the Government to enter into a contract. The FAA will not pay for any information received or costs incurred for preparing responses to this announcement. Therefore, any costs associated with a response to the solicitation are solely at the interested vendor�s expense. Questions are to be submitted, in writing only. title: Advanced Tactical Parachute System (ATPS) Design Optimization - Canopy Release Assembly (CRA)
description: 1.0 Introduction The Project Manager Soldier Survivability (PM SSV), Product Manager Soldier Clothing and Individual Equipment (PdM SCIE), Personnel Airdrop Systems team is conducting market research to identify potential industry sources capable of designing, developing, or providing a modernized Canopy Release Assembly (CRA). This RFI supports the Advanced Tactical Parachute System (ATPS) Design Optimization effort. The Government is seeking information on next-generation release assembly to modernize mass tactical airdrop capabilities. This RFI is issued solely for information and planning purposes and does not constitute a solicitation. 2.0 Background The current ATPS architecture utilizes the legacy Capewell Canopy Release Assembly to allow the jumper to disconnect the main parachute canopy from the harness upon landing, mitigating the risk of being dragged by surface winds. The current fielded CRA components are identified by part numbers 11-1-7350 (female assembly) and 60J4328 (male assembly). The PdM SCIE team is pursuing an ATPS Design Optimization effort to modernize this interface to improve ergonomics, reliability under tension, and ease of actuation for the Warfighter while ensuring absolute fail-safe security during the airdrop sequence. Furthermore, the corrosion issue across the T-11 and MC-6 harness fleet has raised material concerns about the current CRA. 3.0 Technical Requirements / Information Requested The Government requests white papers and technical data packages (if available) detailing proposed replacement components for the Capewell CRA. Proposed solutions must address the following criteria: Primary Objective: Identify a functional, modernized replacement for the existing Capewell canopy release assembly (PNs 11-1-7350 and 60J4328). System Compatibility: The proposed CRA must integrate with the existing T-11 and MC-6 risers and the T-11 harness system. Riser Design: The absolute top priority for this modernization effort is maintaining structural and operational compatibility with the current riser designs. Vendors must provide engineering analysis or proof-of-concept data demonstrating how their proposed release assembly attaches to and operates with standard risers and harness without requiring comprehensive redesigns of either component. Assembly Release Requirement: The proposed release assembly must feature a Static Line style 2-stage release process. The system must require two distinct, deliberate physical actions by the paratrooper to actuate the release, thereby preventing inadvertent deployment during aircraft exit or the opening shock sequence. Material Requirement: The proposed release assembly should feature appropriate plating or other material solutions that address the corrosion issue seen across the T-11 and MC-6 harness fleet. Corrosion considerations include industry salt spray and synthetic sweat exposure tests. Load Ratings: Submission should include information on shock loading, sustained loading, and failure loading characteristics of the proposed release assembly. Industrial Capability: Submissions should address: Current or planned domestic availability in compliance with Buy America Act and/or Berry Amendment if applicable Current or planned manufacturing volume to support parachute production Projected timeframe for ramping up to full rate production Pricing: Submissions should address: Current cost estimate per set of hardware Projected cost estimate for full rate production 4.0 Submission Instructions Responses should be submitted in PDF or DOCX format and must not exceed ten (10) pages, excluding cover pages and technical data appendices (schematics, CAD drawings, etc.). Submissions must include the company name, CAGE code, point of contact, a statement regarding the Manufacturing Readiness Level (MRL) and Technology Readiness Level (TRL) of the proposed Canopy Release Assembly, and business size under NAICS code 314999 (All Other Miscellaneous Textile Product Mills) and NAICS code 332999 (All Other Miscellaneous Fabricated Metal Product Manufacturing). Interested parties may identify their interest and capability by sending responses with information on their current commercial product(s) and how they might address the Military requirement via e-mail ONLY to Mr. Eric Louglin, eric.w.loughlin.civ@army.mil, Mr. Tashfiq Salam, Tashfiq.salam.civ@army.mil, and Mr. Mark Whiteman, g.m.whiteman.civ@army.mil, no later than 29 September 2026. Responses shall provide a courtesy copy to the Contracting Officer and Contracting Specialist points of contact included below.

title: Advanced Tactical Parachute System (ATPS) Lightweight Canopy Fabric
description: 1.0 Introduction The Project Manager Soldier Survivability (PM SSV), Product Manager Soldier Clothing and Individual Equipment (PdM SCIE), Personnel Airdrop Systems team is conducting market research to identify potential industry sources capable of providing advanced, lightweight parachute canopy materials. This Request for Information (RFI) is issued in support of the Advanced Tactical Parachute System (ATPS) Design Optimization effort. The Government seeks to identify commercially available or developmental fabrics that offer significant weight and pack-volume reductions over legacy materials. This RFI is for planning purposes only and does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFP in the future. 2.0 Background The current ATPS heavily relies on legacy parachute fabrics designed to withstand the rigorous deployment forces associated with mass tactical airborne operations. The standard material currently utilized for the T-11 Reserve canopy is PIA-C-44378 Type IV fabric. While this material has demonstrated historical reliability, the ATPS Design Optimization initiative seeks to decrease the overall system weight and bulk burden on the Warfighter. Reducing the weight and packed volume of the reserve canopy system is a critical objective to enhance jumper mobility, aircraft egress efficiency, and overall mission effectiveness. 3.0 Technical Requirements / Information Requested Interested industry partners are requested to provide detailed technical information on proposed canopy fabrics that meet the following objectives and constraints: Primary Objective: Identify a lower-weight and lower-bulk parachute canopy material intended to serve as a direct replacement for the currently utilized PIA-C-44378 Type IV fabric. System Compatibility: Proposed fabrics must be seamlessly compatible with the design and manufacturing processes of the T-11R (Reserve) canopy assembly. Vendors must detail how their material integrates with existing T-11R suspension lines, reinforcement tapes, and packing methodologies. Performance Impact Assessment (Critical Constraint): Industry manufacturers must explicitly detail if, and how, substituting their proposed lower-weight/lower-bulk material will impact, reduce, or alter any other critical performance specifications. Submissions must include comparative data against PIA-C-44378 Type IV baseline metrics, specifically addressing: Tear strength (warp and fill) Tensile strength Air permeability (CFM) Abrasion resistance and long-term durability (UV exposure, snag-ability, etc.) Deployment shock-loading capabilities Relative weight of proposed fabric Pack volume reduction If PFAS-free, provide additional information on performance and manufacturing impacts in comparison to baseline material Seam efficiency Sew-ability Existing use data Industrial Capability: Submissions should address: Current or planned domestic availability in compliance with Berry Amendment and Buy America Act Current or planned manufacturing volume to support parachute production Projected timeframe for ramping up to full rate production Pricing: Submissions should address: Current cost estimate for 1500 linear yds of fabric (typical 48 in width) Projected cost estimate for full rate production 4.0 Submission Instructions Responses should be submitted in PDF or DOCX format and must not exceed ten (10) pages, excluding cover pages and test data appendices. Submissions must include the company name, CAGE code, point of contact, a statement regarding the Manufacturing Readiness Level (MRL) and Technology Readiness Level (TRL) of the proposed Lightweight Canopy Fabric, and business size under NAICS code 314999 (All Other Miscellaneous Textile Product Mills). Interested parties may identify their interest and capability by sending responses with information on their current commercial product(s) and how they might address the Military requirement via e-mail ONLY to Mr. Eric Louglin, eric.w.loughlin.civ@army.mil, Mr. Tashfiq Salam, Tashfiq.salam.civ@army.mil, and Mr. Mark Whiteman, g.m.whiteman.civ@army.mil, no later than 29 September 2026. Responses shall provide a courtesy copy to the Contracting Officer and Contracting Specialist points of contact included below.

title: Denmark – Tents – Udbud af Rammeaftale vedrørende teltservice
description: Udbuddet omfatter en rammeaftale om leje af teltservice til brug for arrangementer, øvelser og events, som afvikles af Ordregiver (”Rammeaftalen”). Rammeaftalen har til formål at dække ETKs løbende behov for leje af telte og tilhørende faciliteter til Forsvarsministeriets og underliggende myndigheders etablissementer. Rammeaftalen omfatter levering af den udbudte ydelse til Ordregivers lokationer i hele Danmark, inkl. ikke-brofaste øer. Der forventes dog alene et mindre behov for levering af ydelser til ikke-brofaste øer. Rammeaftalen indgås for en 4-årig periode, og den anslåede årlige værdi udgør 35.000.000 kr. ekskl. moms – det vil sige samlet 140.000.000 kr. ekskl. moms. Rammeaftalens maksimale værdi udgør 280.000.000 kr. ekskl. moms. Rammeaftalen omfatter leje af Teltservice inklusive følgende ydelser: • Telte til events og sanitære faciliteter • Telte til indkvartering og sanitære faciliteter • Materiale (enkeltvarer), herunder (ikke udtømmende): o Kontor- og beboelsesvogne o Køle- og frysecontainere til opbevaring af mad o Teknisk udstyr (hegn, lys, varme/køl, strøm, kabler, mv.) Rammeaftalen indgås med to leverandører. Opgaver, der tildeles på grundlag af Rammeaftalen, tildeles direkte på de vilkår, der er fastsat i Rammeaftalen, herunder de aftalte priser og øvrige kontraktvilkår. Som udgangspunkt tildeles alle opgaver til 1. prioritetsleverandøren. 2. prioritetsleverandøren tildeles alene en opgave i de i Rammeaftalens pkt. 8 angivne situationer.

title: Germany – Structural shell work – "Dreispitzpassage", Claire-Waldoff-Str. 1/3/5, Reinhardstraße 2, Friedrichstraße 130 A/B/C in 10117 Berlin Leistung: Rohbauarbeiten - VOEK 380-26
description: Schaffung von 44 neuen Wohnungen auf dem Grundstück der Dreispitzpassage durch Aufstockung auf die bestehende Tiefgarage mit Rückbau der Einkaufsmall, Einbau eines begrünten Innenhofes und Anpassung der angrenzenden Gebäudeteile Bauteil G in allen Geschossen und Bauteil A/B und D/E im EG und UG (siehe Übersichtsplan Bauteile). Lage und Städtebau Das Grundstück befindet sich in zentraler Lage im Bezirk Berlin - Mitte. Sieben Häuser mit eigener Erschließung und 6 oder 7 Geschossen, bilden den dreiseitigen Block entlang der Friedrichstraße, der Claire-Waldoff-Straße und der Reinhardtstraße mit der innenliegenden erdgeschossigen "Dreispitzpassage". Entlang des historisch vorhandenen Erschließungsweges zwischen Reinhardtstraße und Claire- Waldoff-Straße, im Folgenden kurz als "Spitzweg" bezeichnet, sitzt der vierte, niedrige Riegel, ein 2-geschossiges Bauteil, bestehend aus Tiefgaragenebene TG 1 im EG und Mall im 1.OG. Hier befinden sich auch die Anlieferungszone der Mall und die Zu- und Abfahrt zur Tiefgarage. Im Inneren des Blockrandes befinden sich ebenfalls eine Tiefgaragenebene TG und darüber eine Ladenebene mit natürlich belichteter, verglaster Erschließungszone. Geplant ist den eingeschossigen Riegel auf der Tiefgarage TG 1 rückzubauen und durch eine 2- 6 Geschosse hohe Aufstockung zu ersetzen. Die innenliegende Mall über Tiefgarage TG wird ebenfalls rückgebaut und durch einen begrünten Innenhof ersetzt. Kenndaten: - Grundstück "Dreispitzpassage" - Adressen: Friedrichstraße 130 A-C, Claire-Waldoff-Straße 1, 3, 5 und Reinhardtstraße 2 - Bezirk: Mitte von Berlin - Gemarkung: Berlin Mitte - Flur: 921 - Flurstück: 373 und 374 - Flächengröße: 7373 m² - Mittlere Geländehöhe: ca. 33,50 m ü.NN Neubau - Aufstockung: Der neue Baukörper beginnt oberhalb der Tiefgaragenebene und schließt mit sechs Obergeschossen an das bestehende, hintere Eckgebäude Claire-Waldoff-Straße 5 an. In Richtung Reinhardtstraße wird die Geschossigkeit wegen der Abstandsflächen zum Nachbarn Reinhardtstraße 6 sukzessive bis auf zwei Geschosse und Dachterrasse reduziert. Der Anschluss zwischen der 6-geschossigen Aufstockung und der Claire-Waldoff-Straße 5 wird nicht als geschlossener Bau hergestellt. Offene, aufeinandergestapelte, "luftige" Terrassenetagen in Stahlbetonbauweise schaffen eine licht- und luftumspülte Verbindung, die eine neue Qualität auf dem Grundstück herstellt und den zukünftigen Bewohnern des Altbaus zu Gute kommt.

title: Germany – Woodwork – Grundschule Wagenstadt - Zimmererarbeiten

Die Grundschule wird über einen Zeitraum von ca. 1½ Jahren umfassend umgebaut und saniert. Das Bestandsgebäude erhält ein zusätzliches Dachgeschoss mit Satteldach sowie ein vollflächiges Wärmedämmverbundsystem mit vorgehängter Fassade. Die Dachkonstruktionen des Bestandsgebäudes sowie der Neubauten sind als vorgefertigte Dachelemente geplant und so auszuführen, dass die Elemente direkt per Kran an ihren jeweiligen Einbauort gehoben und montiert werden können. Das Gebäude wird bis auf den Rohbau vollständig entkernt und anschließend saniert. Südlich des Bestandsgebäudes wird ein neuer Anbau in Stahlbetonbauweise errichtet. Im Gebäudeinneren wird ein neuer Aufzug über alle Geschosse (Erdgeschoss bis 2. Obergeschoss) eingebaut. Für die erforderlichen Aushubarbeiten ist südlich und östlich des Bestandsgebäudes eine Verbaulösung vorgesehen. Nördlich des Bestandsgebäudes entsteht ein neues Treppenhaus in Stahlbetonbauweise, das als zweiter baulicher Rettungsweg dient. Der Zugang zum neuen Dachgeschoss erfolgt über dieses Treppenhaus. Beide Anbauten sind nicht unterkellert und erhalten eine Pfahlgründung. Bei der Herstellung der Baugruben ist die Grundbruchsicherheit des Bestandsgebäudes zwingend zu berücksichtigen. Gegenstand der Ausschreibung sind Zimmererarbeiten für die Sanierung und Erweiterung der Grundschule Wagenstadt in Herbolzheim. Die Leistungen umfassen Schadstoffsanierungs-, Rückbau- und Demontagearbeiten an bestehenden Dachaufbauten sowie die Herstellung von Holztragwerken für Sattel-, Pult- und Flachdächer, Giebelwandkonstruktionen, Dämm-, Beplankungs- und Ausbauarbeiten einschließlich zugehöriger Dachaufbauten und Nebenleistungen. Der Ausführungszeitraum ist von KW19 bis KW29 in 2027 vorgesehen. Die Termine und Einzelfristen erfolgen in Absprache mit der Bauleitung

title: Netherlands – Horticultural services – Onderhoud natuur, terreinen en infrastructuur
description: Deze Europese aanbesteding heeft betrekking op het planmatig en projectmatig onderhoud van natuur, terreinen en bijbehorende infrastructuur binnen de door Dunea beheerde gebieden. De opdracht omvat werkzaamheden in de duingebieden, natuurterreinen en productielocaties van Dunea, met als doel de instandhouding van natuurwaarden, recreatieve voorzieningen en een veilige leefomgeving te waarborgen. De werkzaamheden variëren van regulier onderhoud tot specialistische natuurbeheermaatregelen en projecten. Daarnaast omvat de opdracht onder meer bosbeheer, maaiwerkzaamheden, bestrijding van invasieve exoten, afrasteringen, recreatieve voorzieningen en terreinonderhoud op productielocaties. Dunea zoekt hiervoor professionele partners die beschikken over de benodigde kennis, capaciteit en expertise om deze werkzaamheden duurzaam en veilig uit te voeren. Met deze aanbesteding beoogt Dunea de continuïteit, kwaliteit en beheersbaarheid van het onderhoud voor de komende jaren te borgen en de afhankelijkheid van een beperkt aantal marktpartijen te verminderen. Duurzaamheid, samenwerking, veiligheid en kwaliteit vormen daarbij belangrijke uitgangspunten. De opdracht wordt in meerdere percelen aanbesteed, zodat gespecialiseerde marktpartijen kunnen inschrijven op het deel van de werkzaamheden dat het beste aansluit bij hun expertise. Inschrijvers worden uitgenodigd om aan te tonen hoe zij bijdragen aan een toekomstbestendig beheer van de natuur- en terreinwaarden binnen het werkgebied van Dunea.

title: Sweden – Library software package – Bibliotekssystem och webbplats
description: Ekerö kommun avser att upphandla ett digitalt, molnbaserat bibliotekssystem för folk- och skolbiblioteksverksamhet med tillhörande publik webbplats för folkbiblioteksverksamheten. Syftet med upphandlingen är att säkerställa en långsiktigt hållbar, flexibel och användarvänlig digital infrastruktur som stödjer biblioteken i Ekerös uppdrag att främja läsning, kunskap, delaktighet och demokrati. Bibliotekssystemet och tillhörande publik webbplats ska möta dagens och framtidens behov hos invånare, besökare och medarbetare enligt Bilaga – Kravspecifikation. Kultur- och fritidsförvaltningen i Ekerö kommun är beställare och mottagare av det upphandlade systemet. Nuläge Kultur- och fritidsförvaltningen i Ekerö kommun använder idag bibliotekssystemet Book-IT och den integrerade webbplatsen Axiell Arena Nova. Ekerö kommun uppskattar att cirka 25 medarbetare inom kultur- och fritidsförvaltningen använder systemet och webbplatsen idag. Antalet biblioteksanvändare i bibliotekssystemet idag är cirka 4000 inom skolbiblioteksverksamheten och cirka 10 000 inom folkbiblioteksverksamheten. Antalet besök på den publika webbplatsen uppskattas till cirka 100 000 om året och sker från både mobiltelefon och dator. Tidplan Ekerö kommun planerar att tilldela upphandlingen i november 2026 och har som krav att ett nytt bibliotekssystem med tillhörande installation, migrering och implementation ska vara fullt fungerande och i drift senast 15 mars 2027.

description: Die Grundschule Dorschberg in Wörth a. Rh. wurde 1966 baulich errichtet und liegt hinter dem Mittelbau der Carl–Benz–Gesamtschule in Wörth am Rhein. Die Grundschule besteht aus vier Gebäudeteilen, zu welchen ein ein- bzw. zweigeschossiger Gebäudeteil mit Verbindungsgängen gehört sowie eine Pausenhalle mit einem Verwaltungstrakt und einem eingeschossigen Pavillonbau mit vier Pavillongebäuden. Die Gebäude sind mit Pausengängen verbunden und verfügen über zwei Toilettengebäude. Die ein- bis zweigeschossigen Gebäude wurden in massiver Bauweise mit Beton-Fertigteilen errichtet und weisen Flachdächer in unterschiedlichen Höhenlagen mit umlaufender Attika auf und wurden bis heute mehrfach saniert und modernisiert. Mitte der 1990er Jahre fand eine Betonsanierung statt. In diesem Zuge wurde ein Wärmedämm-Verbundsystem und die Alucobond-Verkleidungen der Attiken und der Fertigteilstützen angebracht. Wesentliche bauliche Maßnahmen - Der bestehende eingeschossige Klassentrakt wird aufgestockt und der bisherige Innenhofbereich zwischen den beiden bestehenden Klassentrakten wird geschlossen und überdacht. Hierzu wird die nicht ausreichend tragfähige Spannbetondecke über dem nördlichen Klassentakt zurück gebaut und durch eine neue Stahlbeton-Massivdecke ersetzt. - Das neue Obergeschoss wird in vorgefertigter Holzbauweise mit tragenden Wänden als Massivholzkonstruktion bzw. Holzständerkonstruktion und oberster Geschossdecke als Brettsperrholzkonstruktion errichtet. - Die zentrale Aula wird mit einer Glasdachkonstruktion versehen. - Die Spannbetondecke im Flurbereich über dem bestehenden Kriechkeller des Nordtraktes muss durch Stahlträger ertüchtigt werden. - Kleinteilige Grundrissänderungen im Bestand - Die Pavillons werden entkernt und zur erweiterten überdachten Pausenhoffläche - Verbesserung des Wärmeschutzes sämtlicher Gebäudehüllflächen (Dachflächen, Fenster, hinterlüftete Holzfassaden, Kellerdeckendämmung) - Modernisierung der technischen Gebäudeausrüstung inkl. kontrollierten Lüftungseinrichtung mit Wärmerückgewinnung, energiesparender Beleuchtungssysteme, Gebäudeautomation, einschließlich der digitalen Anforderungen an Schulgebäude - Optimierung des Brandschutzes und Umsetzung des schulischen Schutzkonzepts
